variables.definition: The chronological age of the human subject in years at the time of study enrolment.
variables.measurement_method: Self-report or verified national identity document / clinical record birth date calculation.
variables.relation_to_outcome: Confounder or covariate; used to adjust primary and secondary outcomes (e.g. periodontal healing rates or bone density changes depend on age).
variables.relation_to_research_question: Population characterization; ensures sample complies with inclusion criteria (e.g. adult cohort aged 18-65).
variables.statistical_test: Independent t-test / ANOVA (for group comparisons) or Multiple Linear/Logistic Regression (as a covariate for adjustment).
variables.reference: ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials (Section 5.7 - Covariates).

variables.definition: Probing Pocket Depth (PPD) measured from the gingival margin to the bottom of the clinical pocket.
variables.measurement_method: Manual probing using a calibrated periodontal probe (e.g. UNC-15) at 6 sites per tooth.
variables.relation_to_outcome: Primary outcome in periodontal intervention trials; reduction in PPD indicates successful treatment response.
variables.relation_to_research_question: Main clinical parameter to answer whether the intervention reduces periodontal pocket depth compared to the control group.
variables.statistical_test: Paired t-test (pre-to-post comparison) or ANCOVA (comparing post-op PPD between groups adjusting for baseline PPD).
variables.reference: Consensus Report on Periodontal Diseases (AAP/EFP guidelines) & STROBE reporting checklist.

variables.definition: Bleeding on Probing (BOP) score calculated as the percentage of probed sites that exhibit bleeding within 30 seconds of probing.
variables.measurement_method: Sensing presence (1) or absence (0) of bleeding at 6 sites per tooth after probing, then dividing by total probed sites.
variables.relation_to_outcome: Secondary outcome indicating active clinical inflammation status of the periodontal tissues.
variables.relation_to_research_question: Secondary question evaluating if the intervention leads to reduction in active tissue inflammation.
variables.statistical_test: Wilcoxon signed-rank test (non-parametric pre-to-post) or Chi-square test (for category proportions like BOP < 10% vs >= 10%).
variables.reference: World Health Organization (WHO) Oral Health Surveys basic methods.

variables.definition: Plaque Index representing the percentage of tooth surfaces covered with dental plaque.
variables.measurement_method: Visual inspection with a dental explorer or disclosing agent across 4 surfaces per tooth, dividing plaque-covered surfaces by total surfaces.
variables.relation_to_outcome: Covariate or secondary outcome; measures patient oral hygiene compliance which affects primary outcomes.
variables.relation_to_research_question: Used to verify that baseline oral hygiene was similar between experimental and control groups (preventing confounding).
variables.statistical_test: Independent t-test (group comparison) or Mann-Whitney U test.
variables.reference: Silness-Löe Plaque Index guidelines & AXIS appraisal tool.

variables.definition: Clinical Attachment Loss (CAL) representing the distance from the cementoenamel junction (CEJ) to the bottom of the pocket.
variables.measurement_method: Periodontal probing measuring PPD plus gingival recession (distance from CEJ to gingival margin).
variables.relation_to_outcome: Primary or co-primary outcome; measures actual skeletal/tissue attachment gain or loss.
variables.relation_to_research_question: Key index to prove true regeneration or loss of attachment in response to the surgical/non-surgical therapy.
variables.statistical_test: Independent t-test, ANCOVA, or Linear Mixed-Effect Models (to account for clustering within patient mouths).
variables.reference: CRIS Guidelines (Reporting In-Vitro Studies) and STROBE standards.

variables.definition: The peak arterial pressure measured during contraction of the left ventricle of the heart.
variables.measurement_method: Automated oscillometric blood pressure monitor or manual auscultation with a sphygmomanometer on the upper arm.
variables.relation_to_outcome: Safety outcome / Covariate; monitors cardiovascular safety of epinephrine-containing local anesthetics during dental procedures.
variables.relation_to_research_question: Ensures safety compliance; evaluates if hemodynamic changes occur during procedures.
variables.statistical_test: Repeated Measures ANOVA (baseline, during procedure, post-procedure) or paired t-tests.
variables.reference: AHA/ACC Hypertension Guidelines & CONSORT Harms extension.

variables.definition: Glycated Hemoglobin (HbA1c) level reflecting average blood glucose levels over the past 2-3 months.
variables.measurement_method: High-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) from a venous blood sample.
variables.relation_to_outcome: Effect modifier or covariate; diabetic control level (HbA1c) significantly influences periodontal healing kinetics.
variables.relation_to_research_question: Stratification / subgroup analysis parameter to assess if treatment works differently in controlled vs uncontrolled diabetics.
variables.statistical_test: Two-way ANOVA (treatment group x diabetic status) or Multiple Linear Regression (HbA1c as an independent variable).
variables.reference: ADA Clinical Practice Recommendations & STARD standards for diagnostic tests.
